profile.title: A shop set up to fix things properly
profile.lead: {company} was established in {year} by skilled and trained technicians and engineers. The company advocates for environmentally friendly repairs through the brands it carries and distributes across the Philippines.
profile.body1: We provide a diverse array of products and services, including the repair, supply and installation of various forklift and hand pallet truck brands, air-conditioning and refrigeration repairs, motor rewinding and reconditioning, fabrication, and the supply and installation of roll-up doors.
profile.body2: That breadth is the point. Warehouses and plants rarely fail in neat categories — a dock leveller that will not lift, a chiller that will not hold temperature, a forklift down on a Monday morning. Having hydraulics, cooling, electrical and fabrication skills in the same team means one call, one assessment and one team accountable for the outcome.
